credential: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate

domains.official_name: Plan and manage an Azure AI solution
Implement generative AI and agentic solutions

competencies.summary: Select model classes and Foundry tools that fit task requirements.
Match Foundry capabilities to generation, grounding, search, agent, and multimodal workloads.
Choose retrieval and indexing approaches for solution needs.
Choose memory, tool, and knowledge services for agent architectures.
Design Azure infrastructure for AI apps and agent workloads.
Select deployment options for AI solutions.
Configure model and agent deployments.
Connect Foundry projects to CI/CD delivery pipelines.
Manage quota, scale, rate limits, and cost for model and agent workloads.
Monitor model quality, drift, safety events, and grounding behavior.
Monitor ingestion quality, search index health, and retrieval relevance.
Configure identity, networking, keyless access, and role policies.
Configure safety filters, guardrails, risk detection, and moderation.
Apply evaluators, safety evaluations, and explanation tools.
Implement trace, provenance, audit, and approval-workflow instrumentation.
Govern agent behavior with oversight, constraints, and tool-access controls.
Deploy and consume language, code, small, and multimodal models.
Implement retrieval-augmented generation in an application.
Design tool-augmented, multi-step, and reasoning workflows.
Evaluate generative applications for fabrication, relevance, quality, and safety.
Integrate Foundry SDKs and connectors into application workflows.
Configure an application connection to a Foundry project.
Define agent roles, goals, conversation tracking, and tool schemas.
Build agents using retrieval, function calling, and conversation memory.
Integrate APIs, knowledge stores, search, content understanding, and custom functions as tools.
Implement orchestrated multi-agent solutions.
Build autonomous or semiautonomous workflows with safeguards and approvals.
Monitor deployed agents, evaluate behavior, and analyze failures.
Tune generation through prompting and model parameter settings.
Implement reflection, reasoning evaluation, and self-critique patterns.
Implement observability for traces, tokens, safety signals, latency, and breakdowns.
Orchestrate multiple models, flows, and hybrid model-plus-rules systems.
Generate images from text prompts and reference media.
Generate videos from text prompts and reference media.
Configure inpainting, mask edits, and prompt-driven image editing.
Implement workflows that edit generated video.
Select generation and editing controls appropriate to the platform.
Analyze visual context with multimodal models.
Configure concise and detailed captions for one or more images.
Answer questions using visual evidence as grounding.
Generate accessible alt text and extended image descriptions.
Use Content Understanding in Foundry Tools to extract visual characteristics.
Process and interpret video segments.
Configure single-task and pro-mode Content Understanding pipelines.
Identify objects, components, or image and video regions.
Classify unsafe or disallowed visual content.
Detect and reduce prompt injection through text embedded in images.
Enforce visual policies such as watermarks, brand rules, prohibited symbols, and inappropriate content detection.
Extract entities, topics, summaries, and structured JSON with prompting and Foundry Tools.
Detect sentiment, tone, safety concerns, and sensitive content.
Translate text using Azure Translator in Foundry Tools or model-powered translation flows.
Customize language-model outputs for domain-specific extraction and summarization.
Convert speech to text and text to speech for agentic interactions.
Integrate speech as an agent modality, including custom speech models.
Enable reasoning over audio inputs in multimodal flows.
Translate speech into other languages with models and Foundry Tools.
Ingest and index documents, images, audio, and video.
Configure semantic, hybrid, and vector search for grounding.
Enrich content with custom and built-in skills for text, images, and layout.
Configure RAG ingestion flows, including document and OCR processing.
Connect retrieval pipelines directly to workflows and agent tools.
Extract document information with multimodal OCR, layout, and field extraction pipelines.
Produce clean grounded document representations for agents and RAG.
Implement Content Understanding analyzers that generate structured or markdown outputs.
